# TDX test vectors

`tdx_quote` and `tdx_quote_collateral.json` are copied unchanged from the `sample/` folder of
[Phala-Network/dcap-qvl](https://github.com/Phala-Network/dcap-qvl) (MIT). They are real Intel evidence, valid
in mid-2025, used to test that our TDX check accepts a genuine quote and rejects tampered ones. They have
nothing to do with Wardy Agent's own TEE evidence.
